Legendary artists such as Frank Sinatra, Rod Stewart, Michael Bublé, Barbra Streisand, and Bing Crosby have all infused their unique styles into this English-language classic, which continues to resonate with audiences today.

Back in 2009, R.I.O. released Serenade, captivating audiences with its catchy beats and vibrant sounds. The group's performance truly brought the track to life, making it a memorable piece from that year.

L'Estaca is a notable protest song composed and performed by Lluís Llach, with the lyrics also penned by him. Released on the first day of 1968, this iconic piece resonates through the Catalan language, reflecting the spirit of its time and place. Llach's powerful performance and the song's compelling message have contributed to its lasting impact.

Pascal Obispo composed the song Love Machine, which is part of the album À la recherche de l'amour perdu. Released at the start of 2007, this album features Melissa Mars as the performer. Interestingly, Mars not only lends her voice to the performance but also contributes her lyrical talents to Love Machine, delivering the words in French. The entire project was brought to the public by Polydor Records.

Bowie's unmistakable baritone brought the song to life, but its influence didn't stop there. Over the years, bands like Turbonegro and the Red Hot Chili Peppers also offered their own renditions, each adding a unique twist to Bowie's vibrant classic.

sent: The beautiful canzone napoletana, Santa Lucia, penned by Teodoro Cottrau, drifts into people's hearts with its melodious Neapolitan lyrics. This timeless piece has found its way into the repertoires of various performers, showcasing its enduring appeal. Among those who have brought this piece to life are Malena Ernman and Åsa Jinder, each offering their unique interpretation. Elvis Presley, too, lent his voice to this classic, embracing its charm and nostalgia. The song has also been performed by Tito Beltrán, whose lyric tenor voice adds a distinctive elegance to the composition.

Diana Ross's album Diana, released on May 22, 1980, showcases her versatility with its blend of rhythm and blues, soul, and pop music. Produced by Nile Rodgers, this iconic album features tracks like I'm Coming Out and Upside Down, which became instant hits. It was released under the legendary Motown label and highlights Ross's powerful voice through its rich English lyrics. One of the tracks, My Old Piano, came out slightly later on September 19, 1980, further expanding on the album's diverse soundscape.

Released in October 1970, Since I've Been Loving You is a track from Led Zeppelin III, a well-received album that came out just a few days after the song itself. The track, penned and produced by Jimmy Page, delves into the raw emotions of the blues genre while also embracing elements of blues rock. Sung in English, the piece showcases the band's ability to blend powerful vocals and instrumentation. In addition to Since I've Been Loving You, the album features other notable tracks such as That's the Way, Immigrant Song, and Friends, highlighting the diverse musical landscape that Led Zeppelin III offers.

Gotta Travel On is a remarkable piece that falls within the realm of contemporary folk music. Crafted with the collaborative efforts of Pete Seeger as the composer, the lyrics were contributed by talented artists Ronnie Gilbert and Fred Hellerman. This song was later brought to life by the iconic performer Bob Dylan, whose interpretation added a unique dimension to its folk roots.

The cherished musical piece P'tite fleur aimée, penned by Jules Fossy, is a beautifully crafted song in Réunion Creole. Its evocative lyrics were brought to life by Georges Fourcade and have resonated with listeners since its publication on August 13, 1930. This timeless creation continues to hold a special place in the hearts of those who appreciate the cultural and linguistic richness it portrays.

Phil Ochs' album "Phil Ochs in Concert," released under the Elektra label, features the folk song *Love Me, I'm a Liberal*. This traditional folk music collection, performed in English, showcases Ochs' signature style and poetic lyrics. The track, with its satirical edge, fits seamlessly into the overall genre of the album, offering listeners a poignant glimpse into the political and social commentary typical of the era.

Johann Sebastian Bach, the renowned composer, created the piece Gott, man lobet dich in der Stille, BWV 120. This work, which is in German, showcases Bach's exceptional ability to blend intricate musical composition with the expressive nuance of the German language. His genius is evident in the way the composition captures the thematic essence, making it a standout piece in his impressive repertoire.

Gott fähret auf mit Jauchzen, BWV 43, a creation by the renowned composer Johann Sebastian Bach, embodies the rich essence of German musical tradition. sent: The classic album Machine Head, produced by Deep Purple, was released on March 25, 1972. A staple of the hard rock genre, the album includes standout tracks like Maybe I'm a Leo, with lyrics penned by Roger Glover, as well as Never Before. Machine Head has long been celebrated for its energetic contributions to the rock music scene, showcasing the band's talent and creativity.

The song Hino dos Açores, with its evocative lyrics penned by Natália Correia, was welcomed into the world on the first day of 1979. This anthem, deeply rooted in Portuguese culture, continues to resonate with its audience, encapsulating the spirit of the Azores through its powerful language.

Roger Waters, known for his distinctive baritone voice, composed and wrote the lyrics for Welcome to the Machine. This track is part of the broader Wish You Were Here album by the iconic band Pink Floyd. The album, which includes Welcome to the Machine in its tracklist, is an exemplary piece of experimental rock. Released under the Harvest record label, the entire album, including its thought-provoking lyrics, is presented in English.

The cantata Gottes Zeit ist die allerbeste Zeit, BWV 106, is one of Johann Sebastian Bach's revered compositions, crafted in the German language. Drawing on rich text and profound spirituality, the composer weaves a narrative that reflects on the themes of time and divine providence, showcasing his mastery of musical and linguistic expression.

This work beautifully blends elements of minimalist and postmodern music, showcasing the distinctive style that Glass is celebrated for. As you explore this composition, you'll find it offers an introspective journey characteristic of its minimalist roots while simultaneously embracing the diverse and eclectic nature of postmodernism.

In the early days of 1970, Pink Floyd recorded Love Scene (Version 4), an instrumental rock piece composed by Richard Wright. This track showcases the band's versatility and features as part of the eclectic album Zabriskie Point. Wright, known for his baritone voice, contributed to this compilation, which spans genres like rock music, stage and screen, and folk. Zabriskie Point includes tracks from various artists, collectively delivering its narrative in English. Among its lineup, you'll also find titles such as Come in Number 51, Your Time Is Up, further illustrating the diverse musical tapestry of this collection.

Schubert's composition remains a striking testament to his ability to marry text and music seamlessly.

I've Got a Feeling, a blues rock track composed by John Lennon, was performed by The Beatles and released at the start of the 1970s. This song was part of the album Let It Be, which features a blend of rhythm and blues music. The album, also performed by The Beatles and produced by Phil Spector, includes tracks such as Dig It. Let It Be was released under the Apple Records label, showcasing the iconic band's diverse musical talents during that era.

Released in the early days of 1972, this track finds its home on the album Obscured by Clouds, adding a unique charm to the collection. Through this piece, listeners experience the seamless blend of Waters' composition and Gilmour's evocative lyrics.

Released on December 21, 1964, this English-language track showcases the combined lyrical talents of Smokey Robinson and Ronald White, who also teamed up as its composers. While Robinson's smooth tenor voice often comes to mind, it's interesting to note that White lent his rich baritone to the creative process behind this timeless piece.

The song Love Always Finds a Reason, performed by Elsa Lunghini, was penned by the talented Diane Warren. This heartwarming track made its debut at the beginning of 1988, captivating audiences with its touching lyrics.

Lead Belly, the renowned artist, beautifully performed the song Goodnight, Irene, which is steeped in the rich traditions of American folk music. This iconic piece showcases the timeless elements of the genre and further cements Lead Belly's position as a pivotal figure in folk music history.

In the world of classical music, the piece Double Canon emerges as a fascinating creation. Composed by Igor Stravinsky, this work first saw the light of day on January 1st, 1959. Stravinsky's composition stands as a testament to his enduring influence on the music scene during that era.

The renowned hard rock anthem, Jailbreak, is a standout track performed by Thin Lizzy. Released on March 26, 1976, under Vertigo Records, this English-language song quickly became a defining piece in the genre. Embodying the quintessential elements of hard rock, Jailbreak has remained a staple in music collections over the decades.

Alto Rhapsody, a remarkable composition by Johannes Brahms, was first published at the beginning of 1870. This work beautifully intertwines the profound poetry of Johann Wolfgang von Goethe with Brahms's intricate musical style. Sung in German, it captures the rich emotional landscape characteristic of both the composer and lyricist. The piece remains a testament to the artistic collaboration between two giants of their respective fields.

Burn, an album that truly embodies the rich blend of blues rock, hard rock, and heavy metal, was released on February 15, 1974. This dynamic and powerful collection, communicated through the universal language of English, includes tracks like Mistreated. Within this piece, Ritchie Blackmore's lyrical talent shines through. Mistreated, a fixture on Burn's tracklist, had its debut slightly earlier, hitting the scene on January 1, 1974. Bringing this electrifying album to the world was EMI, the renowned record label known for supporting groundbreaking projects.

The Twist, a pop music classic, is the brainchild of Hank Ballard, who not only composed the tune but also penned its catchy lyrics. This vibrant English-language song has left an indelible mark on music history, showcasing Ballard's undeniable talent.

In the world of rock and roll, the song Don't Be Cruel stands out as a classic. Crafted by Otis Blackwell, both its composition and lyrics showcase his talent. Released in 1956, this iconic track was brought to life by none other than Elvis Presley, whose performance elevated the English-language song to enduring fame.

Richard Wagner, a prominent figure in classical music, composed the Wesendonck Lieder. This set of songs beautifully showcases his unique style and deep emotional expression, making it a significant contribution to the art song repertory.

Childhood's End, a composition by David Gilmour, finds its place as part of the album Obscured by Clouds. This track is performed by the legendary band Pink Floyd.

Stardust, a jazz classic penned by the talented composer Hoagy Carmichael, features lyrics by Mitchell Parish and was first published in early 1929. This beloved tune, crafted in English, quickly became a favorite for its combination of haunting melody and poetic lyrics. Among its many renditions, Bing Crosby's version stands out, where his rich bass-baritone voice brings a depth that complements the song’s timeless allure.

Der Herr ist mein getreuer Hirt, BWV 112, composed by Johann Sebastian Bach, is beautifully crafted in the German language. sent: In 1881, Johannes Brahms released Nänie, a deeply moving work that combines poetic lyrics by Friedrich Schiller with a rich orchestral and choral arrangement. This nenia, sung in German, beautifully captures themes of mourning and remembrance. The intertwining of Schiller's poignant words with Brahms' masterful composition creates a somber yet uplifting experience, reflective of its genre's traditional elements.

Love went a-riding, a piece composed by Frank Bridge, first graced the world with its melody at the dawn of 1914. This captivating work showcases Bridge's talent and creativity, marking a moment in history when his musical voice resonated with audiences.

Anita Lindman, known for her captivating performances, beautifully brings to life the traditional Swedish piece Små grodorna. This charming song, steeped in the Swedish language, resonates with audiences thanks to Lindman's vibrant interpretation. Her rendition makes it easy to appreciate the cultural and linguistic intricacies woven into the music.

Mozart composed the Coronation Mass, which was published at the start of 1779. This impressive work is brought to life in Latin, adding to its majestic and ecclesiastical feel. The music reflects a time when composers like Mozart were revolutionizing the classical world.

Franz Liszt's composition, Venezia e Napoli, beautifully showcases the expressive range of the piano. This masterpiece captures the essence of its Italian influences through its powerful and evocative melodies. Liszt's virtuosic skills shine through, making it a celebrated piece in the pianist's repertoire.

Released on January 1, 1992, High is an English-language track that belongs to the alternative rock genre. Part of the album Wish, it showcases the creative talents of Simon Gallup and Porl Thompson as composers, with the lyrics penned by Robert Smith, who also lends his tenor voice to the piece. The production of the album was overseen by David M. Allen, adding to the distinctive sound of the song within the wider context of the collection.

Benjamin Britten is the brilliant composer behind the evocative work Saint Nicolas. This musical piece showcases Britten's unique ability to bring stories to life through music, capturing the essence of its subject with his distinctive style.

An iconic track by the talented duo Eurythmics, Sexcrime, showcases the impressive vocals of Annie Lennox. This song, performed entirely in English, highlights the signature style and creative prowess that the band is known for, capturing the attention of audiences around the globe.

The band 10cc brought an electrifying performance to their hit song Blackmail. Known for their innovative musical style, the group delivered an unforgettable experience, captivating audiences and showcasing their expertise.

The choral work Veni Sancte Spiritus is one of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's compositions. Written by the legendary composer when he was just a child, it showcases his remarkable talent at an early age. This piece, crafted with intricate detail, was published on the first day of January in 1768. Its enduring melody continues to captivate audiences, further cementing Mozart's legacy as one of the greatest composers in history.

Back in the early 1960s, Johnny Burnette graced the music scene with the country hit Green Grass of Texas. Mendelssohn's ability to convey profound emotion and spiritual overtones in this particular piece is a testament to his mastery of composition.

Symphony No. 13, a remarkable piece composed by Michael Haydn, made its debut at the start of 1768. The symphony showcases Haydn’s distinctive musical style and offers a glimpse into the artistic expression of that era.

Fifteen is a captivating track that showcases Taylor Swift's unique talent, as she's not just the performer but also the composer and writer of the lyrics. This piece, sung in English, embodies the essence of country pop, a genre Swift has helped redefine. Her storytelling prowess shines through in every verse, making it a memorable addition to her musical repertoire.

The vibrant rock music classic Mr. Blue Sky was composed by Jeff Lynne, whose tenor voice adds a distinct charm to the piece. Released at the start of 1977, the song is a standout track on the album Out of the Blue. This album, performed by the Electric Light Orchestra, features a memorable collection of tunes that have left a lasting impact on the rock genre.

The album Made in Heaven, produced and performed by the iconic band Queen, features a collection of memorable tracks. Released under Hollywood Records, this album includes It's a Beautiful Day, which stands out as part of a captivating musical journey. Additionally, songs like Too Much Love Will Kill You and A Winter's Tale showcase the band's signature style and emotional depth, solidifying the album’s enduring appeal among fans and newcomers alike.

With its rich and emotive Spanish verses, the song continues to resonate deeply with listeners worldwide.

Released in early 1983, the dance-pop hit The Reflex is a vibrant collaboration within Duran Duran, featuring the musical prowess of John Taylor, Nick Rhodes, Roger Taylor, and Simon Le Bon, who also contributed to the lyrics alongside Rhodes and Andy Taylor. As the band's performance brought the song to life, it became an iconic track in their repertoire, showcasing their unique synergy and creativity.

Gilmour, whose deep baritone voice lends a distinctive edge to the piece, also composed the track. Keep Talking sits among other songs like Cluster One on the album, further cementing its place in the era's musical landscape.

Mademoiselle de Paris is a charming piece that enchants listeners with its quintessentially French flair. Crafted by the talented composer Paul Durand, this song was brought to life on January 1, 1948. The beautiful lyrics, penned by Henri Contet, add depth and emotion, perfectly complemented by the delightful performance of Jacqueline François. This collaboration of gifted individuals results in a timeless composition that continues to captivate audiences.

Antonín Dvořák's String Quartet No. 9, a splendid piece of classical music, showcases the rich interplay between a violin, a cello, and a viola. This composition embodies the essence of chamber music, where the delicate harmonies and melodies are woven intricately through the strings, capturing Dvořák's signature style.

String Quintet No. 4, composed by the illustrious Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, is a masterpiece that first graced the world in 1790. This remarkable work showcases a rich and intricate tapestry woven from the harmonious sounds of violins, violas, and a cello. The quintet captures the essence of classical music, with each instrument masterfully contributing to a complex and beautiful interplay that is characteristic of Mozart's genius.

Malcolm Williamson is the composer behind the Organ Concerto, a piece first introduced to the world on January 1, 1961. This captivating concerto is designed for the rich sounds of the organ, complemented by the grandeur of an orchestra. Williamson's composition skillfully weaves the two sonorities together, creating a timeless musical experience.

Cry Me a River, a cornerstone of popular music, was composed and had its lyrics written by Arthur Hamilton. Released at the start of 1953, this English-language classic has captivated audiences for decades. The song gained particular fame through its rendition by Julie London, whose rich mezzo-soprano voice brought an unforgettable depth and emotion to the piece.

Released on the first day of 2013, Mižerja stands out as a unique contribution to country music, performed with finesse by the Klapa Ensemble. This piece merges traditional elements with the soulful spirit of the genre, showcasing the group's exceptional vocal harmonies.

Released on the first day of 1939, South of the Border is a lively tune well-known in the realm of western music. This piece, crafted by composer Michael Carr and lyricist Jimmy Kennedy, is sung in English and captures the essence of the genre. Billy Cotton lent his voice to the performance, bringing the lyrics to life with his distinct flair.

Johan Halvorsen, a celebrated composer, crafted the piece Det bästa av allt, showcasing his exceptional talent and distinct musical style. This work stands as a testament to his ability to blend emotion and melody, making a lasting impact on the listener.

Arno Pardun not only composed but also wrote the lyrics for the impactful musical piece Volk ans Gewehr! Released at the very start of 1931, this work showcases both his musical and lyrical talents, capturing the spirit of its time.

Released at the start of 1963, One Too Many Mornings is a beautiful piece of contemporary folk music penned and performed by the iconic Bob Dylan. With his distinctive baritone voice, Dylan weaves his lyrical magic in English, capturing audiences since its debut. This song is part of the album The Times They Are a-Changin', expertly produced by Tom Wilson.

Ronny composed the German-language song Sierra Madre with lyrics penned by Hans Hee. Bringing this piece to life, the Schürzenjäger took to performing it, resonating with audiences through their unique rendition. The collaboration of these artists resulted in a memorable piece that continues to capture the essence of its origins.
Igor Stravinsky is the brilliant mind behind Symphony in Three Movements. This composition is a testament to his genius and encompasses the innovative spirit he brought to orchestral music.

Hugo Alfvén, known for his significant contributions to Swedish music, composed Barnatro at the beginning of 1884. This piece, one of his earlier works, showcases his budding talent and creative exploration in the realm of romantic music during that period.

Pete Townshend composed Love, Reign o'er Me, an impressive track that The Who performed in English. The Who brought the entire album to life, showcasing their talent in the unique style of a rock opera, a genre that Quadrophenia is firmly entrenched in.

Released as part of Michael Jackson's 1991 album Dangerous, the track Remember the Time exemplifies the collaborative spirit of its creation. Co-composers Michael Jackson and Bernard Belle penned the lyrics, contributing to the song's vibrant soulfulness. Dangerous itself, produced by Teddy Riley, features a diverse mix of genres including hip hop and gospel music, showcasing Jackson's versatility. Besides Remember the Time, other well-known tracks such as In the Closet and Heal the World also grace the album's eclectic tracklist.

Antônio Carlos Gomes, a renowned composer, crafted the opera Maria Tudor, which is presented in Italian. This remarkable work showcases his ability to blend powerful storytelling with the rich traditions of opera.

Serge Lancen is known for composing the Manhattan Symphony, a piece that was first published at the beginning of 1962. This work captures the vibrant and dynamic spirit of the city, reflecting its bustling energy and intricate rhythms.

Der heimliche Aufmarsch is an intriguing piece of industrial folk music composed by Hanns Eisler, with the evocative lyrics penned by Erich Weinert. This German-language work reflects a unique blend of cultural influences and thematic depth, characteristic of its genre.

Felix Mendelssohn crafted the lovely piece Vom Himmel hoch, showcasing his exceptional musical talent. This composition reflects his masterful ability to weave intricate harmonies and melodies, highlighting his influence in the world of classical music.

Antonín Dvořák's String Quartet No. 7 is a remarkable piece in the chamber music repertoire. The composition showcases a splendid interplay of string instruments, prominently featuring both viola and violin. As one immerses in its melodies, the craftsmanship of Dvořák becomes clear through the harmonious balance and intricate dialogue between these instruments.

Hugo Alfvén's Symphony No. 1, Op. 7 in F minor is a captivating piece of music composed for a full symphony orchestra. This early work by the Swedish composer showcases his mastery in creating lush, orchestral textures and dynamic contrasts, engaging listeners with its dramatic and emotional depth. The symphony offers a testament to Alfvén's burgeoning talent during his early career.

Richard Strauss composed the symphonic poem Don Juan, which was introduced to the world on November 11, 1889. This remarkable piece, known for its vivid orchestration and dynamic storytelling, exemplifies the composer's genius in capturing the spirit and complexity of the legendary character it portrays.

Le chemin de fer, Op. 27, a piece for piano composed by Charles-Valentin Alkan, showcases his extraordinary talent. Published at the very start of 1844, this work captures the imagination with its unique portrayal of a train journey. Alkan's ability to evoke the rhythm and energy of a locomotive through the keys is nothing short of remarkable.
The popular song Kufsteinlied was introduced to the world at the beginning of 1947. Since then, it has captured the hearts of many with its melodious charm.

Rejoice in the Lamb, an imaginative work by the renowned composer Benjamin Britten, first made its appearance at the start of 1943. Ralph Siegel composed the musical work Reise nach Jerusalem – Kudüs'e seyahat, which is performed in Turkish. This composition showcases Siegel's ability to blend cultural elements through its vibrant melodies and lyrics.

In this piece, Berg's unique ability to blend emotional depth with structural complexity comes to the forefront, demonstrating why he remains a celebrated figure in the world of classical music.

In early 2008, Taylor Swift released Breathe, a piece that showcases her mezzo-soprano voice against the backdrop of popular music. The song, performed and co-written by Swift herself, draws listeners into its English lyrics, which were crafted with the help of Colbie Caillat. This collaboration added a unique depth to the expressive qualities in the music, further solidifying Swift's presence in the popular music scene.

The album Nevermind, an iconic grunge masterpiece by Nirvana, features the haunting track Polly, composed by Kurt Cobain. This English-language song complements the album's raw sound, which also includes songs like Come as You Are, Breed, and On a Plain. Interestingly, while most know of it for its mainstream hits, Endless, Nameless adds a mysterious edge to the record. Recognized for its influence, Nevermind was even nominated for a Grammy Award for Best Alternative Music Album.

triples.obj: Grammy Award for Best Alternative Music Album

sent: Michael Daugherty, known for his vibrant compositions, delighted audiences with the enthralling Fire and Blood, first introduced to the world in early 2003. This remarkable piece showcases a captivating violin solo, demonstrating his flair for incorporating rich instrumental textures. The intricate interplay of strings and orchestra in Daugherty's work sets it apart as a memorable musical journey.

Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, known for his exceptional contributions to classical music, composed the magnificent Missa solemnis in C minor. This piece stands as a testament to Mozart's ability to evoke deep emotion and spiritual depth through his work.

Gregorio Allegri, a talented tenor, composed the beautiful Miserere, a renowned piece of polyphony. The choral masterpiece showcases his ability to blend voices harmonically and captures the essence of this intricate musical genre.

In 2012, Remady released the album The Original, which features the track Single Ladies. This particular song, showcasing his talents both as a performer and a lyricist, hit the scene later that year on May 18th. Falling under the energetic Eurodance genre, Single Ladies quickly became a highlight of its album, demonstrating Remady's distinctive style and flair within the genre.

Smells Like Teen Spirit, performed by the iconic band Nirvana, emerged as a transformative grunge anthem when it was released in 1991. This song, part of the legendary album Nevermind, was penned in English by Kurt Cobain, Krist Novoselic, and Dave Grohl, who collectively composed its raw and powerful lyrics. Its distinctive sound and rebellious energy have made it a timeless piece in the genre's history.

In the early months of 1929, Jimmie Rodgers introduced the world to a new piece of musical art with the release of Waiting for a Train. This song, deeply rooted in the country music genre, quickly captured the hearts of many. Known for its emotional storytelling and Rodgers' distinctive vocal style, the track stands as a classic example of the genre's rich tradition.

Hand in Hand is a catchy pop tune that showcases the talents of the band Koreana. Sung in Korean, the song gained popularity for its vibrant energy and the group's dynamic performance. This pop anthem has left a lasting impression on fans worldwide with its upbeat tempo and inspiring lyrics.

Frank Bridge composed the beautiful piece Berceuse, H. 9, which saw its debut at the start of the 20th century. Specifically, this enchanting work was published on January 1, 1901, capturing the essence of its era with its delicate melodies and harmonies.

Aulis Sallinen's Chaconne is a captivating piece, masterfully composed for the organ. The work showcases the instrument's rich, resonant tones, bringing out the unique qualities that only an organ can produce. Sallinen’s skillful composition allows the listener to experience the full depth and complexity of this enchanting piece.

Ottorino Respighi's Feste Romane, a vibrant piece scored for a full symphony orchestra, was brought to life for audiences at the dawn of 1928. This work, steeped in the tradition of program music, vividly evokes the sights and sounds of Roman festivities, capturing listeners' imaginations with its rich orchestral textures. By intricately weaving together various musical motifs, Respighi invites the audience on a sensory journey through Rome's illustrious celebrations.

Frank Bridge's composition, The hour glass, features beautifully crafted piano instrumentation. This piece, which was brought to the public's attention at the start of 1920, showcases Bridge's unique style and deep understanding of the dynamics between melody and harmony. Through the piano, he successfully captures a range of emotions, making it a cherished work from the early 20th century.

Sergei Prokofiev composed the film score for Alexander Nevsky, which first saw the light of day at the start of 1939. This work, a true testament to Prokofiev's mastery, continues to be celebrated for its evocative and powerful themes that perfectly capture the essence of the film it accompanies.

Among Joseph Haydn's impressive body of work lies Symphony No. 17, a testament to his genius and contribution to the classical music world. This piece, like many of his symphonies, showcases his masterful ability to weave intricate compositions that resonate with timeless elegance. Through it, Haydn continues to captivate audiences, offering a glimpse into the musical expertise that solidifies his name in history.

The Perilous Night, a striking composition for piano, was crafted by the innovative composer John Cage. Released at the beginning of 1944, this work showcases Cage's unique approach to music during that period.

"Classical Gas," an iconic piece of easy listening music, is a standout track from The Mason Williams Phonograph Record. This album, released at the dawn of 1968, showcases Mason Williams' skillful performance across its tracks. Crafted under the expert production of Mike Post, the record falls under the easy listening genre and was launched through Warner Bros., a well-known record label of the time.

Burning of the Midnight Lamp is a rock music piece penned and composed by the iconic Jimi Hendrix. Released on the 19th of August, 1967, this track showcases his lyrical prowess, all in the English language. Hendrix, with his distinct baritone voice, breathes life into the song, making it a remarkable addition to his musical repertoire.

The song Wonderful Life, released by Black on January 1st, 1986, stands as an emblematic piece of pop music from the era. Sung beautifully in English, it features the distinct baritone voice of Black himself, who not only performed but also composed this timeless classic. The mellow tones and introspective lyrics of Wonderful Life have made it a standout track, resonating with audiences well beyond its initial release.

The pop music album The Immaculate Collection features the track Rescue Me, an energetic piece co-composed by Madonna and Shep Pettibone. This song stands out not only for its catchy rhythm but also for its lyrics crafted by the duo. Madonna's vocal performance on the track showcases her dynamic range, with elements of both her mezzo-soprano and soprano abilities coming to the forefront. The album overall is a testament to her influence in the pop genre.

And the Band Played Waltzing Matilda, composed and penned by Eric Bogle, made its debut in the world of music on the first day of 1971. This English-language piece is a notable contribution to the genre of popular music. Its poignant lyrics and haunting melody have resonated with listeners since its release.

sent: Johann Sebastian Bach composed Komm, du süße Todesstunde, BWV 161, a piece beautifully rendered in the German language. This choral work highlights Bach's profound ability to infuse emotion through both composition and lyrical expression. The use of German not only serves the piece's somber theme but also enhances its depth and resonance.

Released on March 19, 1971, the album Aqualung by Jethro Tull has made a significant mark in the progressive and folk rock genres. This iconic album, produced under Chrysalis Records, includes noteworthy tracks such as Aqualung, Locomotive Breath, Mother Goose, and My God. The complex and evocative lyrics of this work were penned by Ian Anderson, contributing to the album's lasting legacy in the world of music.

Stevie Wonder, showcasing his signature tenor voice, not only composed but also performed and wrote the lyrics for the funk track Higher Ground. Released on the 1st of July in 1973, this song is in English and appears as part of the album Mother's Milk. The vibrant energy and soulful melodies of this piece truly highlight Wonder's remarkable talent.

The Harmonic Concerts, a collection of musical works, were composed by the talented Unico Wilhelm van Wassenaer. This set showcases Van Wassenaer's skill and creativity, making it a notable contribution to the world of classical music.

Sweet Little Sixteen, a classic piece of rock and roll, comes to life through the genius of Chuck Berry. Known for both his composition and his lyrical prowess, Berry's signature style is evident throughout the song. The catchy rhythm and lively melody encapsulate the essence of rock and roll, making it a timeless favorite among fans of the genre.

Karlheinz Stockhausen, known for his innovative contributions to 20th-century music, composed Sirius in the late 1970s. Released on the first day of 1977, this piece marked a significant point in his career.

Hubert Parry, a renowned composer, is known for his creation Jerusalem. This piece, which falls under the genre of liturgical music, has captured audiences with its harmonious melodies. Sung in English, it has become a staple in various cultural and religious events, admired for both its musical composition and the uplifting message conveyed through its lyrics.

No More I Love You's is a captivating piece originally composed by David Freeman and Joseph Hughes. The lyrics, penned by Hughes, unfold in English, bringing out the emotional depth of the song. This evocative track was brought to life by The Lover Speaks, whose performance adds a unique texture and resonance to the already compelling composition.

The song Dosed is a part of the album By the Way, released by Warner Bros. Records and produced by Rick Rubin. This English-language album came out on the first day of 2003, ushering in a fresh year with its unique sound and style.

Andante and Finale, a piece enriched by the collaboration of two renowned composers, Tchaikovsky and Taneyev, offers a captivating blend of piano and orchestral sounds. The intricate interplay between the pianist and the orchestra in this work showcases the unique styles of both composers, merging Tchaikovsky's emotive expressiveness with Taneyev's structural precision. The result is a harmonious composition that enthralls listeners with its dynamic range and lyrical beauty.
The influential treatise Gradus ad Parnassum first saw the light of day in the year 1725. Written in Latin, this seminal work has long served as a cornerstone for musical instruction and composition.

Aaron Jay Kernis composed the Symphony in Waves, embracing the symphony genre with his distinctive flair. Released at the dawn of 1989, this work unfolds its rich tapestry in English, showcasing Kernis's mastery and innovation in modern classical music.

Animal Boy, released on May 1, 1986, stands as a quintessential punk rock album by the legendary Ramones. With its raw energy and English lyrics, the album was produced by Jean Beauvoir and brought to the public by Sire Records. Within this spirited collection is the track Somebody Put Something in My Drink, which had already made its way to listeners earlier that year, on January 1. This song, like the rest of the album, showcases the Ramones' signature punk rock sound and rebellious vibe.

sent: The Twa Sisters is a fascinating piece steeped in the genre of the supernatural ballad. It weaves an intriguing narrative that captures the eerie and mystical elements characteristic of such works. This traditional ballad carries listeners to a world where the haunting and the otherworldly intermingle, offering an experience that is both chilling and captivating.

Released on the first of December in 1962, the festive classic Rockin' Around the Christmas Tree has charmed listeners with its unique blend of country music and rock and roll vibes. Crafted by Johnny Marks, this enduring holiday hit has been brought to life by several performers over the years. Among them, Mel and Kim and the band Arvingarna have contributed their distinct interpretations, adding their own flavors to this well-loved tune.

Johan de Meij's Symphony No. 2, known as The Big Apple, made its debut on January 1st, 1993. This captivating piece uniquely blends the sounds of a symphony orchestra with those of a concert band, offering a rich and dynamic experience. The work's instrumentation allows for a diverse range of musical textures, highlighting de Meij’s skill in composing for both types of ensembles.

The track Sleazy is a collaborative masterpiece that brings together several talented figures from the music world. Among them, Dr. Luke and Bangladesh both contributed their composing talents. The lyrical aspect of the song was crafted by Klas Åhlund, who also played a role in its composition, and Benny Blanco. This blend of creative inputs makes for a unique musical experience.

Ludwig van Beethoven, a master of his craft, composed the Eroica Variations for the piano, showcasing his inventive genius and depth. This remarkable work made its debut at the beginning of 1803, adding another notable piece to Beethoven's impressive repertoire. The composition exemplifies his pioneering spirit and transformative impact on classical music.

The piece Wójnski kěrluš, which first appeared at the start of 1806, is notable for being written in Lower Sorbian. This language, often overshadowed by more predominant European tongues, adds a unique cultural and linguistic dimension to the work, making it a significant part of the musical heritage from that period.

Summer '68, a track from Pink Floyd's album Atom Heart Mother, showcases the lyrical talent of Richard Wright. Written in English, this song blends seamlessly into the progressive rock tapestry of the album. The composition reflects Wright's unique voice and lyrical depth, contributing to the song's distinct character within the larger work.

Six Degrees of Inner Turbulence is an engaging piece by Dream Theater that showcases their prowess in the progressive metal genre. Released on January 29, 2002, the album, produced by John Petrucci, was brought to life under the Elektra label. Mike Portnoy penned the lyrics for this project, adding depth to its English-language storytelling. Despite its elaborate composition, tightly linked parts, and progressive themes, the work stands as a cohesive creation from beginning to end.

The track Relax was brought to life by the talents of Holly Johnson and Peter Gill, with Johnson not only composing but also penning its lyrics. Released on October 24, 1983, this song showcases Johnson's tenor voice, which adds depth and character. Sung in English, Relax became an iconic piece that resonates with its audience.

The song Mr. Roboto, performed by the band Styx, is a notable track from their concept album Kilroy Was Here. Composed by Dennis DeYoung, whose tenor voice played a central role in its delivery, this piece stands out for its unique blend of rock and theatrical elements.

Muss i denn, a piece deeply rooted in the Swabian culture, dates back to the early 19th century, specifically the onset of 1827. This timeless song, which is a fine example of traditional folk music, captures the essence of its regional heritage while continuing to resonate with audiences through its classic melody.

Skandal im Sperrbezirk is a notable rock and roll piece composed by Günther Sigl. This energetic song is part of the album Dolce vita and is delivered in the German language, adding to its authentic and captivating charm.

The song Oh mia bela Madunina, composed by Giovanni D'Anzi, first graced the public with its presence on January 1, 1934. D'Anzi not only penned this beloved tune, but also lent his voice to its performance. Alongside him, the piece has been brought to life in various renditions by talented artists like Gianni Magni and Nanni Svampa. Despite the passing years, this classic continues to evoke a sense of nostalgia through the diverse interpretations of these performers.

Traces of Sadness is an album that showcases the genre of album-oriented rock and is released under the Bros Music label. This English-language collection includes tracks like Tough Enough and Don’t Go Too Fast. Among these songs, When the Indians Cry, released on August 23, 2004, stands out as a poignant piece, enriching the album's overall emotional depth.

Released on September 8, 2003, WAT is an album by the band Laibach, and it features a blend of industrial music. A standout track from the album, Tanz mit Laibach, is performed in German and showcases the distinctive style of the group. The project was brought to life under the banner of Mute Records, staying true to Laibach's signature sound and artistic expression.

Back in 2011, the song Biga Oneun Naren captured many hearts with its release. The talented group HIGHLIGHT delivered an unforgettable performance that added to the song's charm and appeal, earning it a special place in the world of music.

Lovefool, a catchy tune performed by The Cardigans, made its debut on August 10, 1996. This English-language track seamlessly blends elements of pop and pop rock, capturing the hearts of listeners with its infectious rhythm and relatable lyrics.

Adolf Jensen's piece Wanderbilder is written for the piano, reflecting the composer's fondness for the instrument. Jensen's work often captures intricate emotions, and this particular composition is no exception, showcasing his skill in creating evocative piano music.

In 2011, the album Virgin was released under Pledis Entertainment, featuring a lively mix of dance-pop tunes. One of its notable tracks, Because of You, is a vibrant example of the genre. Both the album and the track are in Korean, adding to the distinctive appeal of the collection. Another energetic anthem, Bang!, is also part of Virgin's dynamic tracklist, making the album a memorable entry in the music scene of that year.

The classic Chicago blues tune I Just Want to Make Love to You, composed and with lyrics provided by Willie Dixon, was first published at the start of 1954. Sung in English, this timeless piece showcases the remarkable talent of Muddy Waters as its performer.

This evocative work showcases the interplay between the piano and viola, creating a rich tapestry of sound. The combination of these instruments highlights Schumann's skill in melding storytelling with musical expression.

Johann Sebastian Bach composed Selig ist der Mann, BWV 57, which is a captivating piece. This work, known for its rich musical expression, is rendered in German, adding to its depth and cultural resonance. Bach's mastery is evident throughout the composition, making it a noteworthy example of his musical genius.

A Hard Rain's a-Gonna Fall, a hallmark of folk music, was released at the beginning of 1963 as part of The Freewheelin' Bob Dylan album. Bob Dylan, known for his distinctive baritone voice, both composed and performed this English-language piece, infusing it with his signature lyrical depth. This iconic track accompanies other classics like Blowin' in the Wind and Don't Think Twice, It's All Right on the same album, showcasing Dylan's talent and influence during that era.

sent: Meeresstille und glückliche Fahrt, composed by the renowned Ludwig van Beethoven, was first published on the first day of 1822. This piece, whose title translates to Calm Sea and Prosperous Voyage, is rendered in the German language, reflecting the cultural and linguistic background in which Beethoven crafted this masterful work.

Nights in White Satin, a well-loved piece in popular music, showcases the creative talents of Justin Hayward, who not only composed the haunting melody but also penned its poetic lyrics. Released at the beginning of 1967, this English-language song is elevated by Hayward's rich tenor vocals. It found its true expression through the performance by The Moody Blues, captivating audiences with its evocative themes and memorable sound.

The song War, released on January 1, 1970, stands as a prime example of progressive soul, blending powerful melodies with English lyrics. This impactful piece was crafted by the talented duo Barrett Strong and Norman Whitfield, who both composed and penned the lyrics for the track. Their collaboration resulted in a musical work that not only highlighted their individual talents but also left a lasting impression on the genre's evolution.

Felix Mendelssohn composed the piece Calm Sea and Prosperous Voyage, drawing inspiration from the words of Johann Wolfgang von Goethe. This musical work beautifully captures the essence of Goethe's German text, blending the power of music with evocative poetry to convey a sense of tranquility and optimism. The collaboration between Mendelssohn's composition and Goethe's lyrics results in a harmonious fusion of sound and language, celebrating both artistic visionaries in the process.
Pēteris Vasks crafted the beautiful String Quartet No. 4, a testament to his remarkable skills as a composer.

Lust for Life is an energetic track by Iggy Pop, released on August 29, 1977, under RCA Records. The song bursts with the raw intensity of garage rock while also incorporating elements of hard and punk rock, making it a standout piece in Pop's discography. Sung in English, it is a vibrant part of his broader musical exploration and was part of the music scene that defined the late '70s.

Johann Sebastian Bach composed a beautiful piece titled Sehet, welch eine Liebe hat uns der Vater erzeiget, BWV 64. This work, rendered in the German language, showcases the depth and elegance that Bach is renowned for. The title, roughly translating to "Behold, what love the Father has shown us," reflects the emotive and spiritual themes typical of his compositions.

Released under the Universal Music Group label, Super Girl showcases a vibrant mix of melodies that keeps fans coming back for more.

Antonín Dvořák, a renowned composer, crafted the beautiful String Sextet, a piece that showcases a rich blend of string instruments. This work features the violin, cello, and viola, creating a harmonious interplay of sounds. With its intricate melodies and expertly woven harmonies, the composition highlights Dvořák's mastery in writing for strings, offering listeners a captivating musical experience.

Jimi Hendrix, the legendary guitarist and composer, crafted the rock classic Little Wing, a standout track characterized by its soulful melody and poetic lyrics. This English-language piece is part of his renowned album Axis: Bold as Love, which also features the song Up from the Skies. Released on December 1, 1967, the album was distributed by Track Record and MCA Records, exemplifying Hendrix's innovative artistry during that era.

No Woman, No Cry, a classic reggae masterpiece penned by Vincent Ford, first resonated with audiences when it was released on the first day of 1974. Sung in English, this song gained worldwide fame through the soulful performance of Bob Marley & The Wailers. The heartfelt lyrics, written by Ford, continue to evoke a deep emotional response from listeners even today.

One of Johann Sebastian Bach's remarkable compositions is the Prelude And Fugue in E-flat Major. This piece, beautifully crafted for the organ, showcases Bach's mastery in blending intricate melodies. Each instrument contributes to the quintet's harmonious blend, demonstrating Dvořák's mastery in orchestration.

Sequenza is a remarkable composition crafted by the Italian composer Luciano Berio. His work in this piece showcases an innovative approach to musical expression, reflecting Berio's ability to push the boundaries of contemporary music.

Released at the start of 1979, Hey You stands as a poignant creation penned by Roger Waters and performed by Pink Floyd. This track is part of the iconic album The Wall, which is celebrated for its enthralling journey into progressive rock. The album not only includes Hey You but also notable tracks like The Trial. Waters’ lyricism shines throughout, with Pink Floyd delivering a memorable performance that has left a significant impact on music history.

Cyndi Lauper, in collaboration with Rick Chertoff, composed the lively tune She Bop. Released at the very start of 1983, this popular track features lyrics penned by Chertoff. The song is a testament to Lauper's unique style and creativity.

The song Radio Free Europe, released on July 1, 1981, is a classic piece by the band R.E.M., where each member played a significant role in its creation. Michael Stipe's baritone voice brings life to the lyrics, which were a collaborative effort among band members Stipe, Bill Berry, Mike Mills, and Peter Buck. The composition of this iconic track was equally a team venture, with Stipe, Berry, Mills, and Buck all contributing to its musical arrangement. Sung in American English, the song showcases the unique style and synergy of R.E.M.'s members.

Julieta Venegas brought her unique style to the album Limón y sal, a release that showcases her versatility by blending alternative rock and Latin pop. This musical work didn't go unnoticed, as it received nominations for both the Latin Grammy Award for Album of the Year and the Best Alternative Music Album category. Venegas's artistry truly shines through in this acclaimed piece of her discography.

sent: Beyond the Sea, originally composed by Charles Trenet and Albert Lasry, is a classic tune that many people associate with the smooth sounds of its era. With lyrics crafted by Trenet himself, the song first found its way to listeners in the early days of 1959. Sung in English, it has been brought to life by numerous performers, including the notable Harry James and His Orchestra. This timeless piece continues to enchant audiences with its captivating melody and evocative lyrics.

Sergei Prokofiev composed the Flute Sonata, which was published on January 1, 1944. This elegant piece, highlighting Prokofiev's genius, features the melodic interplay between piano and flute. The sonata captures the essence of chamber music from that era, showcasing the unique timbre and melody each instrument can bring to a performance.

The pop hit Need You Now, penned by Charles Kelley, is a compelling creation from the talented singer-songwriter Hillary Scott. This English-language track has resonated with audiences worldwide, combining heartfelt lyrics with a captivating melody that showcases the genre's appeal.

The classic song I Knew You Were Waiting (For Me) showcases the incredible talent of Simon Climie, who not only penned the lyrics but also composed the music. This energetic duet was brought to life by the legendary Aretha Franklin, whose powerful voice gave the piece its enduring appeal.

sent: Eddy Grant's album File Under Rock, released on January 1, 1988, showcases a vibrant blend of rock music and features diverse tracks, including the popular Gimme Hope Jo'anna. While the album is performed in Swedish, Gimme Hope Jo'anna brings worldbeat and reggae flavors to the mix, making it a standout piece. Parlophone had the honor of being the record label for this eclectic collection.

Thomas Tallis, a renowned composer of the Renaissance, crafted the choral masterpiece Spem in alium, which was published at the dawn of 1570. Written in Latin, this extraordinary forty-part motet remains a testament to Tallis's genius and the rich tapestry of vocal music during that era.

Onward, Christian Soldiers is a classic English Christian hymn that has touched many hearts over the years. It was composed and performed by Arthur Sullivan, whose musical talents brought the piece to life. The inspiring lyrics were penned by Sabine Baring-Gould, adding depth and meaning to the song. This hymn has become a staple in many religious ceremonies and gatherings, celebrated for its uplifting message and beautiful melody.

The Italian Concerto, composed by Johann Sebastian Bach, was published at the start of 1735. This delightful piece was crafted specifically for the harpsichord, showcasing Bach's ability to blend the lively spirit of Italian music with his own intricate style.

Oyfn Pripetshik is a song deeply embedded in the Yiddish language, capturing the essence of its cultural roots and traditions. The lyrics, delivered in Yiddish, beautifully convey the song's poignant themes and timeless melodies, ensuring its place in the hearts of those who value its linguistic and cultural significance.

Bob Dylan, the genius behind Just Like a Woman, not only composed the music but also penned the heartfelt lyrics. Released on the first day of 1966, this piece of popular music is performed in English. It finds its place within the iconic album Blonde on Blonde, which is celebrated for its blues rock genre. This track stands as a testament to Dylan's influence on the musical landscape of the time.

The Adélaïde Concerto, a captivating piece for violin, has long sparked interest due to its attribution to both Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and Marius Casadesus. While some claim it to be the work of the legendary Mozart, others suggest that Casadesus, himself a notable composer, had a significant hand in its creation. This interplay of historical figures and the violin's rich tones gives the concerto its enduring allure in the classical music repertoire.

In a Mellow Tone, crafted by the legendary Duke Ellington and featuring lyrics by Milt Gabler, emerged into the world of music in the early days of 1940. This timeless piece falls gracefully within the jazz genre, epitomizing the smooth and relaxed elegance so characteristic of Ellington's compositions. Since its release, the work has become a staple in jazz repertoires, celebrated for its ability to evoke a sense of calm and introspection.

Bob Marley's distinctive tenor voice resonates beautifully in the song Slave Driver, showcasing his unique style and commanding presence. This legendary performer captivates listeners with his emotive delivery, embodying the spirit and message of the music. Marley's ability to convey deep meaning and powerful emotion shines through in this piece, leaving a lasting impact on audiences worldwide.

Back in the early 1960s, Flanders and Swann brought a unique flair to the world of novelty music with their release of Slow Train. This piece, which debuted in 1963, showcases the duo's signature wit and charm. Known for its playful and humorous style, the novelty track stands out as a testament to their exceptional ability to blend comedic elements with musicality.

Voor outer en heerd, a piece with its roots in Dutch culture, was crafted by the composer Armand Preud'homme. The evocative lyrics of this work were penned by Jozef Simons. Together, they created a composition that resonates deeply with its audience through its melody and poetic language.

Tony Banks composed Dance on a Volcano, a track that showcases the dynamic energy and intricate musicianship of the band Genesis. Released on February 1, 1976, this piece highlights the stunning collaboration between its talented members.

The iconic rock piece Band on the Run demonstrates the musical genius of Paul McCartney, who composed it while collaborating with Linda McCartney on the lyrics. It's delivered by the talented performers from Wings and was released under Apple Records. This English-language song is part of the album of the same name and includes the energetic track Nineteen Hundred and Eighty-Five, further establishing the album's rock credentials.

The iconic synth-pop track Smalltown Boy, released by Bronski Beat in 1984, features the creative efforts of Jimmy Somerville, Larry Steinbachek, and Steve Bronski. These talented individuals not only composed the music but also penned the lyrics for the song. Known for its powerful commentary, the piece is delivered in English with Somerville's distinctive countertenor voice at the forefront.

Bob Dylan crafted and performed Rainy Day Women #12 & 35 in his signature English, both writing the lyrics and composing the melody. This track is part of his celebrated album Blonde on Blonde, which was brought out by Columbia Records on June 20, 1966. The album, also presenting tracks like Just Like a Woman, showcases Dylan's unique artistry and includes Rainy Day Women #12 & 35, adding to its eclectic mix. As a testament to his talent, Dylan not only delivered the vocals but brought these compositions to life, securing his place in music history.

Hark! The Herald Angels Sing, a beloved Christmas carol and hymn, has lyrics penned by Charles Wesley and a melody composed by the renowned Felix Mendelssohn. First published in 1739, this timeless piece is celebrated in its original English. Known for its festive and reverent tone, the carol has been beautifully performed by artists such as Susan Boyle, with her rich mezzo-soprano voice, and Carola Häggkvist.

Heinz Holliger's Partita, composed for the piano, made its debut at the very beginning of 1999. This intricate piece showcases Holliger's mastery in crafting compositions that resonate with timeless beauty and complexity.

Tostaky, an album performed and produced by Noir Désir, features the song Lolita nie en bloc, which was released on January 1, 1993. The lyrics for this track were penned by Bertrand Cantat. This iconic work, released under the Barclay label, is performed in French, further contributing to its unique charm and allure. Noir Désir's distinct musical style can be sensed throughout, especially in the poignant delivery of Lolita nie en bloc.

In early 1977, the world was introduced to Harlene, a musical work that marked its beginning on January 1st. This piece, with its release on the cusp of a new year, set the stage for the sound and spirit of that era.

The poignant Italian ballad La solitudine, famously performed by Laura Pausini, first graced the music scene on January 1, 1993. With its heartfelt lyrics penned by Pietro Cremonesi and Federico Cavalli, the song captures the essence of separation and longing. The haunting melody, a collaborative creation by Angelo Valsiglio and Cremonesi, beautifully complements the evocative words, ensuring this piece resonates deeply with listeners.

Released on the first day of 1983, *Suzanne* is a captivating piece that showcases the collaborative genius of Ferdi Lancee, who not only composed the music but also penned the heartfelt lyrics. This song gained an additional layer of charm through the performance by VOF de Kunst, whose melodic interpretation brought it to life.

Gleichwie der Regen und Schnee vom Himmel fällt, BWV 18, crafted by Johann Sebastian Bach, first graced audiences in the mid-19th century, specifically in 1852. Rendered in the eloquent tones of the German language, this composition showcases Bach’s masterful ability to blend lyrical beauty with intricate musical forms, offering listeners both historical depth and timeless elegance.

sent: Ricky Martin's album Sound Loaded, which features tracks like Amor and Nobody Wants to Be Lonely, is a vibrant expression of dance-pop, with a touch of Spanish flair woven throughout. Among these hits is She Bangs, a song that not only showcases Martin's pop music prowess but is also an integral part of the album's lively mix. The album masterfully blends upbeat rhythms and energetic melodies, characteristic of Martin's captivating style, and has left a lasting mark on the genre.

Ronald Stevenson composed an impressive piece for piano known as Passacaglia on DSCH, which was published at the start of 1963. This intricate work showcases Stevenson's profound understanding of the instrument, allowing the pianist to explore a wide range of dynamics and emotions.

Released on September 8, 1975, "SOS" emerged as a classic piece with its lyrics penned by the talented trio of Björn Ulvaeus, Benny Andersson, and Stig Anderson. This iconic track, composed by Björn Ulvaeus, holds a significant place in the world of music, especially with the original performance by ABBA. Over the years, its enduring appeal led to performances by a variety of artists, including Erasure, Cher, the A-Teens, and Simons, each bringing their unique flavor to the song.

The Trumpet Concerto in E-flat major is a remarkable work composed by Joseph Haydn. Though originally written in the late 18th century, it wasn't published until the beginning of 1929. This piece showcases Haydn's brilliance and inventive approach to the trumpet, a testament to its lasting appeal and significance in the world of classical music.

The song Echoes, composed by Roger Waters and performed by the iconic band Pink Floyd, first made its debut on October 1, 1971. This progressive rock piece later became a part of Echoes: The Best of Pink Floyd, a collection that was released on November 5, 2001 and showcases the band's signature sound, blending genres like space rock and art rock. Both the song and the compilation are presented in English, allowing their intricate and expansive melodies to connect with a wide audience.

sent: The classic song Lady Jane, performed by The Rolling Stones, captures the essence of the 1960s with its distinctive sound and poetic charm. Released on June 1st, 1966, this track highlights Mick Jagger's dual role as both its composer and lyricist. The tune weaves a narrative that showcases Jagger's lyrical prowess and continues to resonate with fans decades after its debut.

Johann Strauss II is the brilliant composer behind Champagner-Polka, a lively and effervescent piece that perfectly captures the spirit of celebration. His mastery in crafting such vibrant compositions is evident in this work, showcasing his renowned ability to infuse music with joy and sophistication. The piece remains a delightful testament to his enduring legacy in the world of music.

ABBA's iconic 1981 pop album, The Visitors, is packed with memorable tracks including Head over Heels and the evocative The Visitors. Produced by the talented duo Benny Andersson and Björn Ulvaeus, this album encapsulates the essence of the group's music during that era. A standout track, When All Is Said and Done, which also fits seamlessly into this album, was released shortly afterward, cementing its place in English pop music history. Published under the Polar record label, the album showcases the unmistakable sound of ABBA.

sent: The symphonic rock piece Moments of joy, brought to life by the band Kayak, features lyrics penned by the talented Ton Scherpenzeel. This work embodies a fusion of majestic rock instrumentation and lyrical depth, offering listeners an enchanting auditory experience.

Viljo Vesterinen brought the lively rhythms of Finnish culture to life with his performance of Säkkijärven polkka. This piece, celebrated for its energetic accordion arrangement, stands as a testament to the rich tradition of Finnish music. Vesterinen's rendition showcases not only his incredible talent but also the dynamic nature of the polkka, which captures the spirit of its language and heritage.

In 1963, the unique piece So You Want To Write A Fugue? made its debut. Composed and penned by the multifaceted Glenn Gould, this work showcases his talents not only in playing but also in composition and lyric writing. This composition, written in English, presents a fascinating exploration of the complexities and creativity involved in writing a fugue.

sent: Justin Bieber, known for his distinct tenor voice, performs the pop rock track Down to Earth. Released on November 17, 2009, the song features heartfelt lyrics penned by Bieber himself, showcasing his talent both as a performer and a songwriter. This piece stands out in his discography as an early example of his ability to blend poignant themes with a catchy musical style.

Walking on Sunshine is a popular track composed and written by Kimberley Rew, and it's performed in English by the band Katrina and the Waves. This vibrant piece has become an iconic staple of popular music, thanks to its catchy melody and upbeat lyrics.

The track Sysyphus, featured on the album Ummagumma, showcases the creative talents of Richard Wright, who not only composed the piece but also penned its lyrics. This musical work is brought to life by the iconic band Pink Floyd, serving as a testament to their experimental sound. Wright's unique compositional style, evident in this piece, contributes to the distinct and atmospheric quality of Ummagumma as a whole.

Franz Schubert composed Ungeduld, a piece that beautifully intertwines the expressive lyrics of Wilhelm Müller. First published on the first day of 1824, this work captivates audiences with its piano and vocal arrangements. Sung in German, the song stands as a testament to Schubert’s masterful ability to convey deep emotions through both melodic structures and the rich poetic language of Müller.

Mathis der Maler, a grand opera composed by Paul Hindemith, showcases the brilliance of German composition. This remarkable opera takes audiences on a journey through both its rich historical context and its powerful musical expression. Hindemith skillfully weaves together drama and music, capturing the essence of its German roots, which resonates strongly with audiences worldwide.

Johann Sebastian Bach composed the cantata Wer mich liebet, der wird mein Wort halten, BWV 59. This beautiful piece is sung in German, and it reflects Bach's deep-rooted connection to both spiritual themes and the expressive potential of his native language.

sent: William Schuman, an influential American composer, brought Symphony No. 3 to life on the first day of 1941. This pivotal work, which debuted at the start of the turbulent 1940s, showcases Schuman's distinctive style and musical insight. The symphony is regarded as a significant milestone in 20th-century American classical music.

Lotte Schuffenhauer not only composed but also wrote the lyrics for the Christmas carol So viel Heimlichkeit. This festive piece premiered on the first day of 1970, marking its place in holiday music with both its melodic charm and evocative lyrics. As a seasonal favorite, Schuffenhauer's creation captures the essence of Christmas through its harmonious arrangement and thoughtful words.

Johann Sebastian Bach composed the cantata Ach Gott, vom Himmel sieh darein, BWV 2, which is set to lyrics written by Martin Luther. This piece beautifully exemplifies their collaboration and is performed in German. The work is a testament to both Bach’s musical genius and Luther’s profound lyrical contribution.

sent: Aulis Sallinen's compositional flair is beautifully exemplified in his work Variations for Orchestra, which debuted on the first day of 1963. Scored for a full orchestra, this piece showcases Sallinen's ability to weave intricate variations and textures. As an orchestral piece, it brings together a diverse array of instruments to create a captivating musical experience that reflects the innovative spirit of its time.

The album Lichter der Stadt, a pop rock collection released on March 16, 2012, offers a vibrant blend of sounds in the German language. Among its tracks is So wie du warst, which leans more towards pop music. This album captures a diverse range of musical styles, intertwining lively rhythms with emotive lyrics.

Cesária Évora's soulful rendition of Sodade perfectly embodies the essence of coladeira. Known for her emotive voice, Évora brings out the poignant longing within this genre, captivating listeners with its unique rhythms and heartfelt melodies. Sodade stands as a quintessential example of coladeira, with Évora as its unforgettable performer.

The synth-pop classic People Are People was released in early 1984 as part of the album Some Great Reward. This track, performed by Depeche Mode, stands out with its catchy melody and thought-provoking lyrics, both crafted by Martin Gore. Not only did Gore compose the music, but he also penned the lyrics, contributing to its enduring popularity.

I Can't Make You Love Me is a poignant song that beautifully captures the essence of unrequited love with its heartfelt lyrics penned by Allen Shamblin and Michael Barry Reid. Released at the start of 1991, this piece belongs to the popular music genre and is performed in English. Bonnie Raitt brings the song to life with her soulful rendition, making it a timeless piece that resonates with many listeners.

sent: The iconic track Poison, composed by Alice Cooper, burst onto the music scene at the very start of 1989, quickly becoming a hallmark of hard rock. This powerful anthem, with its electrifying guitar riffs and gripping vocals, captures the essence of the genre and has left a lasting impact on rock fans worldwide.

The Vaterländischer Künstlerverein, a lesser-known gem in the classical repertoire, features a beautiful arrangement for the piano. This particular instrumentation highlights the delicate nuances and expressive range of the instrument, inviting listeners to appreciate the artful interplay between the piano's melodies and harmonies.

Instrumedley is a fascinating progressive metal piece, blending the creative genius of Jordan Rudess and John Myung. The two composers infuse the work with complex rhythms and melodic depth, showcasing their expertise in the genre. This masterpiece highlights their extraordinary flair for creating compelling metal compositions.

Released on January 1, 1983, the song Sweet Dreams (Are Made of This) showcases the musical genius of Annie Lennox, who, alongside David A. Stewart, crafted its memorable lyrics. A signature piece in the English language, it is performed by the Eurythmics and notably features Lennox's distinctive contralto voice. Not only is it a highlight on the album Sweet Dreams (Are Made Of This), but it also stands as a testament to the duo's creative synergy.

Joseph Haydn, a master of the classical era, composed the String Quartet, Opus 76, No. 4. This piece, part of a larger collection of quartets, showcases Haydn's brilliance in chamber music and his ability to blend emotion with intricate harmonies. The String Quartet exemplifies his skillful craftsmanship and remains an important work in classical music repertoire.

Barry Gibb composed Woman in Love, a classic ballad performed by both Barbra Streisand and Carola Häggkvist. This English-language song, which became a hit, was released on August 16, 1980. Its timeless appeal lies not just in its emotional lyrics and melody, but also in the powerful interpretations by its performers.

Candy and a Currant Bun, a song by Pink Floyd, showcases the creative genius of Syd Barrett, who not only composed but also wrote its lyrics. Released in the spring of 1967, it became available to the public in March and again in April of the same year. The track, sung in English, captures the essence of the psychedelic pop genre, which was emblematic of its era.

In the Flesh, composed and written by Roger Waters, is a powerful piece that serves as a key part of Pink Floyd's iconic album The Wall. A staple of progressive rock, the track showcases the band's signature sound and style. The Wall, performed by Pink Floyd in its entirety, includes a number of other standout tracks such as The Trial, In the Flesh?, Outside the Wall, and The Happiest Days of Our Lives. Each piece contributes to the album's cohesive narrative and profound musical journey.

triples.obj: The Happiest Days of Our Lives

sent: I Believe I Can Fly, crafted and performed by R. Kelly, is a remarkable piece that beautifully blends elements of gospel, contemporary R&B, and soul music. This English-language track has captivated listeners with its uplifting message and powerful melodies. It showcases how diverse musical genres can come together to create something truly inspirational, highlighting Kelly's multifaceted talent as both a composer and a performer.

Hasta Mañana, a pop music piece predominantly composed by Björn Ulvaeus and Stig Anderson, with lyrics also by Ulvaeus, is an intriguing work sung in English. It's performed by the renowned group ABBA and was also once covered by Simons. This track is part of the album Waterloo, which is known for its pop rock style. The blend of pop and rock genres within the album showcases ABBA's versatility and skill in creating catchy tunes.

In 1816, Luigi Cherubini, a distinguished composer, introduced the world to his Requiem in C minor. This significant piece reflects the depth of Cherubini's musical genius at the time, offering listeners a compelling and evocative composition that has withstood the test of time.

Love the Way You Lie (Part II), composed by Alex da Kid, is one of the tracks featured on the album Loud. This album, released on November 12, 2010, showcases an eclectic mix of genres, including dance-pop, hip hop, and contemporary R&B. Tricky Stewart played a pivotal role in bringing the vibrant sounds of Loud to life, taking the helm as the producer.
